description: This file implements nl80211 event handling for wireless interfaces, including parsing, callback management, and event registration for various wireless events such as scan, wiphy, interface, radar, and regulatory changes.

methods.name: s_commonEvtCb
methods.description: Common callback for event processing, checks for null pointers and listener presence.

methods.name: s_mgmtFrameEvtCb
methods.description: Handles management frame events, parses management frames, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_mgmtFrameTxStatusEvtCb
methods.description: Handles management frame transmission status events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_unspecEvtCb
methods.description: Handles unspecified events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_newWiphyEvtCb
methods.description: Handles new wiphy events, parses wiphy info, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_delWiphyEvtCb
methods.description: Handles wiphy deletion events, parses wiphy info, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_newInterfaceEvtCb
methods.description: Handles new interface events, parses interface info, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_vendorEvtCb
methods.description: Handles vendor-specific events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_delInterfaceEvtCb
methods.description: Handles interface deletion events, parses interface info, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_scanStartedCb
methods.description: Handles scan start events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_scanAbortedCb
methods.description: Handles scan aborted events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_scanResultsCb
methods.description: Handles scan result events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_radarEvtCb
methods.description: Handles radar detection events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: s_regChangeEvtCb
methods.description: Handles regulatory domain change events and notifies listeners.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_msgName
methods.description: Returns the message name for a given nl80211 command ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getEventParser
methods.description: Retrieves the event parser function for a specific event ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_hasEventHandler
methods.description: Checks if a listener has a handler for a specific event ID.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_updateEventHandlers
methods.description: Updates the event handlers for a listener.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_getEvtListenerHandlers
methods.description: Retrieves the data and handlers associated with a listener.
